assertion.text: Erdős Problem #184: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Any graph on $n$ vertices can be decomposed into $O(n)$ many edge-disjoint cycles and edges. Current best: The best bound available is due to Buci\'{c} and Montgomery \cite{BM22}, who prove that $O(n\log^*n)$ many cycles and edges suffice, where $\log^*$ is the iterated logarithm function. Prize: no. Tags: cycles, graph theory.
